title: Law to excuse residents cleaning up from sanitation tickets
summary: This bill would bar the Department of Sanitation from issuing violations, tickets or summonses for residential sidewalks and similar areas during scheduled enforcement periods if a resident is present and actively cleaning or getting ready to clean. It would apply to the existing 8-9 a.m. and 6-7 p.m. enforcement windows. The law would take effect 120 days after being enacted.
